evaluation_basis: Exclusively pct_30 (the percentage of Nicopoly's published catalog in that category that ranks in TOP 30 positions)

EXCELENTE.semantic_meaning: Strong organic visibility. At least 30% (or 70% in ML) of our published items in this category appear on the first page.
EXCELENTE.managerial_meaning: Healthy organic traffic share; minimal immediate intervention required.

BUENA.semantic_meaning: Solid organic visibility with room for optimization.

MEDIA.semantic_meaning: Subdued visibility. Only 10-25% of catalog reaches top 30 positions.
MEDIA.managerial_meaning: Risk of organic sales loss; consider pricing or sponsored push.

CRITICA.semantic_meaning: Near-total organic invisibility in the top 30 search results.
CRITICA.managerial_meaning: CRITICAL RISK: A category marked as 'CRITICA' does NOT mean the product is missing, unpublished, or out of stock. It means our products are buried past position 30 on the category search page. A manager must NOT interpret 'CRITICA' as catalog loss, but as poor search rank.

risk_level_mapping.BUENA: MEDIO (Visibilidad aceptable pero con margen de mejora)
risk_level_mapping.MEDIA: ALTO (Baja visibilidad, alto riesgo de no venta)
risk_level_mapping.CRITICA: CRITICO (Invisibilidad casi total en el marketplace)

managerial_guidance: Eliminate the ambiguity where managers panic thinking products are unpublished when labeled CRITICA. The dashboard must clearly distinguish PUBLICATION STATUS (Published vs Unpublished) from VISIBILITY STATUS (Top 30 Visibility).
